acceptance.corpus: Three beams crossing a cube mesh, one missing it
acceptance.tolerance: collision count equals 3

acceptance.corpus: Start-index option
acceptance.tolerance: elements before index excluded from count

statement: Generate truss geometry on a supplied surface in Pratt, Warren, K, diamond or Vierendeel patterns with subdivision counts and local member orientations, with optional node relaxation.
superiority: Dino 8 should create the truss as native parametric BIM members linked to the surface.

acceptance.corpus: Planar 10 m x 2 m surface, Warren pattern with 10 divisions
acceptance.tolerance: member and node counts equal closed-form counts exactly

acceptance.corpus: Curved surface Pratt truss
acceptance.tolerance: all chord nodes lie on the surface within 1e-9 m

statement: Clean a model by straightening junction elements at nodes with more than two neighbours, removing duplicate lines and points, and finding groups of connected elements.

source.ref: Simplify Model / Connected Parts / Remove Duplicate Lines

superiority: Dino 8 should run these checks automatically during assembly with a fix-it list and undo.

acceptance.corpus: Model with two disconnected frames
acceptance.tolerance: two connected groups returned, largest first

acceptance.corpus: Line set with 30 duplicates
acceptance.tolerance: duplicates removed exactly; counts reported

statement: Connect nearby but unlinked elements by adding links when their shortest distance falls below a threshold, with limits on segment length and number of new connections.
superiority: Dino 8 should preview proposed connections and allow per-link approval.

acceptance.corpus: Two crossing beams 3 mm apart with 5 mm threshold
acceptance.tolerance: one connecting element inserted

acceptance.corpus: Cap on new connections set to 10
acceptance.tolerance: exactly 10 connections created

statement: Run components asynchronously with cancellation and optional parallel execution so the interface stays responsive during large analyses.
superiority: Dino 8 should keep a responsive viewport by design with background solves that are cancellable and compatible with optimisation loops.

acceptance.corpus: 100k-DOF static analysis while orbiting viewport
acceptance.tolerance: viewport frame time stays under 50 ms during solve

acceptance.corpus: Cancel pressed mid-solve
acceptance.tolerance: solver stops within 1 s with model state unchanged
